breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 240 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.2.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflict between the final time (T=0.2), the time step (dt=0.001), and the number of steps (240). It correctly recalculated the number of steps to be 200 (since 0.2 / 0.001 = 200) and stated this in the generated specification, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
